results.root_cause_actual: The v2.14.0 deployment increased WORKER_CONCURRENCY from 8 to 32 without increasing the DB_POOL_SIZE, causing up to 32 concurrent workers to compete for only 10 database connections. This exhausted the connection pool, forcing workers to queue and time out, resulting in 500 errors and an 11.4% 5xx rate.
results.root_cause_expected: Deploy v2.14.0 raised WORKER_CONCURRENCY from 8 to 32 while leaving DB_POOL_SIZE at 10 with max_overflow 0, so 32 concurrent workers contend for 10 database connections and block in pool acquire until the 30s timeout, exhausting the connection pool.

judge.reason: Both identify the same specific change (WORKER_CONCURRENCY increased to 32 while DB_POOL_SIZE remained at 10) and the same mechanism (connection pool exhaustion due to resource contention), with the candidate providing additional details about the resulting symptoms.
